purpose: Executed run specification for the two complete, verbose Build-A candidate suites. It maps every audited issue, all 34 original exceptions, and all twenty-seven repair-time findings to exact unittest identities and records only directly observed execution status.
execution_record: Both declared commands executed from the unchanged Build-A candidate after the ten-step replay completed and the SQLite WAL was absent or zero bytes.
Each exact relative log contains that command's complete combined stdout and stderr without concatenating another unittest invocation.
Both commands returned the directly observed integer exit code 0; neither log contains a skip or expected failure requiring classification.
Counts, observed test identifiers, byte sizes and hashes are intentionally omitted here and reconstructed from the complete logs by implementation/build_test_run_manifest.py.
